name: Ultra S9 5G Android Smartwatch 32GB Ram+256GB Rom With Dual Camera
description:
Type	Smart Watch
SIM	Yes
Display	2.02-inch, 320 x 386p
CPU	SL8541E, Quad-core ARM CortexTM A53 MP with up to 1.4GHz speed
Camera	Yes
Connectivity	Bluetooth V4.2
Sensors	Accelerometer sensor, Gyroscope, Step counting, Heart rate sensor, Barometer, Compass
Battery	700mAh
Operating System	Android
Protection	Waterproof

Processor type: SL8541E, Quad-core ARM CortexTM A53 MP processor, up to 1.4GHz. –
Description
This S9 Ultra 5G smartwatch is powered by an SL8541E quad-core ARM CortexTM A53 MP processor with up to 1.4GHz speed and appears with a 2.02-inch display that supports a resolution of 320 x 386p. The S9 Ultra features a variety of sensors, including an accelerometer sensor, gyroscope, step counting, heart rate sensor, barometer & compass.
